title: File comments — frosting and opening reliably

steps.path: Open a document → select text → Add comment
steps.headline: The comment box frosts the text behind it instead of letting words show straight through.
steps.changed: The box now floats above the file pane’s visual layers. It keeps the same theme-controlled glass, border and shadow as the file and code right-click menus used as references.
steps.notice: The document text behind the box no longer competes with what you are typing. This follows the guide’s shared, theme-painted popup surface.
steps.risk: Solid themes stay solid, and Reduced effects still controls blur. These pictures select the whole document only to make text behind the box easy to compare.

steps.path: Session files → q3-sales-by-rep.xlsx → Comments → Shrink panel → right-click a cell → Add comment
steps.headline: Try adding a comment after shrinking the Comments panel back to its marker rail.
steps.hint: Open Session files, choose q3-sales-by-rep.xlsx, press Comments, then Shrink panel. Right-click a cell and choose Add comment. A focused typing box should open beside the rail. You can also test the frosted box in normal Reading mode.
steps.changed: A new comment now opens its typing box even when Comments mode is still active but only the slim rail is visible.
steps.notice: You no longer need an extra click on the new marker to begin typing. Resizing does not replay an already-handled popup.
steps.risk: This is the shared renderer with practice files and a fake backend; it does not save comments into your real documents.
